cases.prompt: Here's my 70-second script about starting my company. Create an animation for it with a voiceover.
cases.why: names candidate formats and the production route, asks for reference photos of the real person, and shows one style frame before any full build
reject: builds the full timeline before the format is confirmed

cases.prompt: Make a 45-second animated explainer about how our API rate limits work, for LinkedIn in 1:1.
cases.why: style comes from the new brief and LinkedIn 1:1 framing, never from an earlier film's rig, palette or Instagram safe zones
reject: reuses the earlier film's colour script

cases.prompt: Make a 30-second hand-drawn stop-motion animation about a cat who learns to code, for X. Here's a screenshot of the cat.
cases.why: named format is confirmed in one line, one agent with a storyboard, designed from the screenshot, content-grown transitions and seeded randomness
reject: parallel animators and a judge panel for a 30 second piece

cases.prompt: Use the animated-video skill to make a short animated video about a story you come up with.
cases.why: story is directed first: intake questions in one message, three concepts, a timed beat sheet, then wait for approval
reject: writes the storyboard before the user approves the beat sheet
